get.description: Report whether the API is up and can reach the database.

delete.description: Deletes the module with all its topics, assessments, tasks and materials.

get.description:
The module's topics as a nested tree, siblings in position order, each with the
number of material pages linked to it, its confidence and its workload (the student's
figure, or estimated from its slides and text pages), and for a topic with subtopics the
workload of the whole subtree (decision 0019).

delete.description: Deletes the topic and all its subtopics.

get.description:
How far the AI topic map has got: materials analysed of those eligible, the merge,
and whether jobs are waiting for AI rate limits to reset (`waiting_until`).

Analyse every eligible material not analysed yet, then merge into the topic tree.

Existing topics are never renamed, moved or deleted; only new topics are added.

get.description: Each eligible material's topic extraction: analysed, failed (with why), or waiting.

schema.title: Response Material Topic States Modules  Module Id  Topic Map Materials Get

Find this material's topics again: a new run with a fresh AI call budget.

422 if its topics aren't extracted (AI off, a kind that isn't analysed, or not ready).

delete.description:
Delete every topic still marked AI. Topics the student made or edited stay.

The materials' proposals are kept, so building again re-merges without re-analysing.

post.description: Confirm an AI topic as it is: it becomes the student's, counted as kept.

Fold this topic into ``target_id``: its subtopics, cited pages and page links move
there, then it's deleted. Returns the target. 422 for a topic in another module, the
topic itself, or one of its subtopics.

Delete an AI topic (and its subtopics still marked AI) and remember the names, so a
merge never adds them again. The student's subtopics move up. 422 if it isn't AI.
Confirm every topic still marked AI.

schema.title: Response Dismissed Topics Modules  Module Id  Dismissed Topics Get

The pages linked to a topic, grouped by material: cited by the AI, or similar

Your tasks across all modules, soonest due first (undated last).

Repeat ``status`` to keep only those statuses, e.g. ``?status=todo&status=in_progress``.
The module's tasks, soonest due first (undated last).

schema.title: Response List Module Tasks Modules  Module Id  Tasks Get

patch.description: Setting status to "done" records completed_at; any other status clears it.

post.description:
Open a session with its start event (201).

Resending the same start event returns the existing session (200). Only one
session can be open at a time (409).

get.description: Your open session with its events (to resume the timer after a reload), or null.

schema.title: Response Get Active Session Sessions Active Get

post.description:
Add timer events, in any order. Already-stored ids are skipped if unchanged (409 if not).

The whole log is replayed: an impossible sequence (e.g. resume while active) is a
422 and nothing in the batch is saved.

put.description: Save the end-of-session reflection, replacing any earlier one (ended sessions only).

get.description: A page of the module's sessions: the open one first, then newest first.
Measured study time for the module: all time, and since `week_start` (your local week).

post.description:
Upload one file (at most 50 MB) to the module and queue it for processing.

The same file twice in one module is a 409; a wrong type is a 415.

get.description: The module's materials, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Materials Modules  Module Id  Materials Get

patch.description: Change the title, the kind or whether AI may process it.

delete.description: Delete the material (its file too, unless another of your modules has the same file).

post.description: Queue a failed material for processing again.

get.description: The extracted pages (without their text), in order. Empty until extraction has run.

schema.title: Response List Pages Materials  Material Id  Pages Get

get.description: One page's extracted text.

The original file, for the viewer. Cached for good (the ETag is its sha256), so an
If-None-Match with that ETag gets a 304. 404 for another user's material or a lost file.

Search the module's materials by meaning and by words (hybrid, reciprocal rank fusion).

Each result is one chunk of one page. `indexed_chunks` is 0 until a material is indexed.

post.description:
Start a tutor conversation in the module, optionally for a study session and a topic.

Without a topic, the session's topic is used. Retrieval boosts the topic's pages.

get.description:
The module's tutor conversations, newest first, each with its messages.

`?study_session_id=` keeps one session's (the tutor panel restores it after a reload).
Another user's session ID gives `[]`, like a missing one.

schema.title: Response List For Module Modules  Module Id  Tutor Conversations Get

get.description: The conversation with its messages, oldest first, and each answer's sources.

post.description:
"Quiz me": 3 multiple-choice questions on the last answer's sources (not streamed).

The question ("Quiz me") and the answer are stored like any other turn; the answer is
`failed` with a readable `text` when the AI's quiz couldn't be used. Questions whose
sources weren't among the answer's are dropped, so there may be fewer than 3. 422 when
nothing has been answered yet; 503 (with Retry-After) when the AI is busy.

503.description: No AI model can take it now; Retry-After says when to try again

patch.description:
Save the student's picks for a quiz: one per question, null if not answered yet.

The app grades them in code (the correct index is in the quiz); nothing about mastery or
the plan changes. 422 if the message isn't a quiz or the count doesn't match.

Record a spoken question's latency, measured in the browser: from releasing
push-to-talk to the first spoken word, with its parts. No audio is ever sent. 422 unless
the message is an answer.

post.description:
Ask a question; the answer streams as server-sent events, in this order:

- `sources`: the sources the answer is given (label, material, page), before any text;
- `delta`: a piece of the answer's text (many);
- `done` (the answer ended: message id, status, model, time to first token, cited
  labels) or `error` (a readable message, and when to retry if the AI is busy).

The question is stored at once, the answer when it ends. If the client disconnects,
the provider's stream is stopped and the partial answer is stored as `stopped`.

contentSchema.title: Streamitem Ask Conversations  Conversation Id  Messages Post

get.description: The timezone availability is written in, and the most study time a day.

patch.description:
Change the timezone (IANA), the daily cap (15 to 1,440 minutes), or how many minutes
before a block its push reminder comes (5, 10, 15 or 30; null turns reminders off).

get.description: Weekly windows, by weekday (0 is Monday) then start.

schema.title: Response List Rules Availability Rules Get

post.description:
A weekly window, "HH:MM" to "HH:MM" local time ("24:00" ends at midnight). 409 if
it overlaps another window that weekday.

get.description: Exceptions by date, optionally from and to a local date (inclusive).

schema.title: Response List Exceptions Availability Exceptions Get

post.description:
One date that doesn't follow the rules: ``unavailable``, or its own ``windows``.
409 if that date already has one.

get.description:
Each local date from ``from`` to ``to`` (inclusive, at most 62 days): its free
intervals in UTC (exceptions over rules, DST-safe), free minutes, and the minutes
available after the daily cap.

patch.description:
Set the topic's confidence (1 to 5, self-rated) or its workload in minutes (the
student's own figure). Null clears either: "not rated", or back to the estimate.

get.description:
The plan for the next ``days`` local dates (1 to 62, default 28), computed now and not
stored: each block with its reason and study method in words (written by code, no AI),
and the feasibility report per assessment and overall.

The current plan version (number, trigger, summary, report) and its blocks that overlap
the local dates ``from`` to ``to`` (default today to 7 days on; at most 62 days), with
their status and texts. With no plan yet, this creates version 1 (trigger initial): the
one GET with a side effect.

The current plan's next planned block that hasn't ended (one in progress counts), or
null.

schema.title: Response Get Next Block Plan Next Get

post.description:
Skip a planned block of the current plan and re-plan at once (its time is placed
again). 409 for any other block; 404 for one that isn't yours.

Re-plan now (trigger manual). Returns the current version: a new one only if the
blocks changed.

Move a planned block of the current plan that hasn't started and has no session to
``start`` (5-minute grid; it keeps its length), then re-plan with it pinned there. 422
with one sentence if it can't go there; 409 for any other block; 404 if it isn't yours.

get.description: Whether reminders can be sent from this server, and the key to subscribe with.
Your devices with reminders on (never their endpoints).

schema.title: Response List Subscriptions Push Subscriptions Get

post.description: Save this browser's subscription (201), or refresh it if it's already saved (200).
Send "Reminders work" to each of your devices now, and say how each went.

get.description: Whether the link exists, when it was made and last fetched. Never the token.

post.description:
Create the private calendar link, or reset it (the old link stops working). The URL is
returned this once.

get.description: Your plan as an .ics file, for the Download button.
The plan of the user this link belongs to (no sign-in: the token is the key).
The topic's last 10 generations, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Generations Topics  Topic Id  Practice Generations Get

get.description:
Your items, newest first, each with its sources (label, material, page). With
``subtopics``, ``topic_id`` covers the topic's subtopics too, as mastery does.

post.description: Your own card or question (origin user).

patch.description:
Editing an AI item's text makes it yours (origin user); its sources stay. Rejecting
needs a ``reject_reason``.

post.description:
Record an answer's grade, 1 (again) to 4 (easy), and schedule the item with FSRS. The
student always chooses the grade: ``marked_by`` is "ai" only when it's the grade an AI
marking suggested, sent back as ``ai_marking`` (422 otherwise, or when the marking doesn't
fit the item). 409 for a suspended or rejected item. Returns the review, the new due time
and the queue's counts. Reviews are never changed.

get.description: The item's reviews, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Reviews Practice Items  Item Id  Reviews Get

post.description:
Ask the AI whether a short answer covers each of the item's key points (ADR 0029).

Sends the question, the reference answer, its key points and your answer: nothing else
about you. Code derives the verdict and the suggested grade (all covered: Good; at least
half: Hard; fewer: Again); the AI never grades. Stores nothing. 422 for a flashcard; 409
for a suspended or rejected item; 503 (with Retry-After) when every model is busy.

502.description: The AI's marking couldn't be used; mark it yourself

503.description: No AI model can take it now; Retry-After says when to try again

get.description: For each grade, when the item would be due if reviewed now, and as a short label.

Due items (oldest due first), then new items up to today's allowance (oldest first),
with the counts.

patch.description:
New items a day (0-200) and desired retention (0.80-0.97). A new retention applies to
later reviews only.

get.description:
Every topic in tree order with its mastery now: an estimate of how well you know it, from
your reviews, Quiz me answers and ratings. Never an exam prediction.
One topic's mastery now (its subtree's practice; see the module endpoint).

Which AI providers have a key (yes/no only), each role's models, and today's usage.

Usage counts the current user's requests since each provider's daily quota reset.

post.description:
Test every configured model with one short request each, all at once.

A model whose daily budget is used up isn't called. Each call is logged in ai_usage
(purpose "ping") against the current user. Errors carry the provider's text, never a key.

AIMarking.title: AIMarking
AIMarking.description:
A marking (``POST /practice/items/{id}/mark``), and the same object sent back with the
review it led to. The verdict and the suggested grade must be what code derives from the
coverage, so a client can't record one the AI didn't give.

BlockActionsOut.title: BlockActionsOut
BlockActionsOut.description: What the student can do with a block now, decided by the server (decision 0022).

file.title: File
file.description: PDF, PPTX, DOCX, MD, TXT, PNG or JPG

CalendarFeedOut.title: CalendarFeedOut
CalendarFeedOut.description: Whether a calendar link exists, and when it was made and last fetched. Never the token.

ConversationCreate.title: ConversationCreate
ConversationCreate.description:
Both optional. A study session must be in the module; without a topic, the session's
topic (if any) is the one retrieval boosts.

DeltaEvent.title: DeltaEvent
DeltaEvent.description: A piece of the answer, in order.

DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent
DoneEvent.description: Last, when an answer was given (``truncated`` if it hit the output limit).

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description:
Last, when no full answer was given. Any text already streamed is kept as a
``failed`` message.

Estimate.title: Estimate
Estimate.description: A number shown to the student: always estimated here, with its sample size.

EventBatch.title: EventBatch
EventBatch.description: Events to add, in any order. Ids already stored are skipped if unchanged.

ExceptionUpdate.title: ExceptionUpdate
ExceptionUpdate.description: ``unavailable`` and ``windows`` are checked together once merged with what's stored.

ItemCreate.title: ItemCreate
ItemCreate.description: The student's own card or question.

ItemPageOut.title: ItemPageOut
ItemPageOut.description: A page an item cites, once however many of its passages are cited.

ItemUpdate.title: ItemUpdate
ItemUpdate.description:
Text edits make an AI item the student's (decision 0009). ``reject_reason`` is
required when, and only when, the status becomes rejected.

retrying.title: Retrying
retrying.description: A failed attempt is waiting to be retried (`error` says why it failed).

MaterialTopicStatus.title: MaterialTopicStatus
MaterialTopicStatus.description: Where one eligible material's topic extraction stands (the Materials tab).

MessageSourceOut.title: MessageSourceOut
MessageSourceOut.description: A source the answer was given. ``material_id`` is null once the material is deleted.

ModuleSessionSummary.title: ModuleSessionSummary
ModuleSessionSummary.description: Measured study time for a module (active time only; breaks aren't study time).

PageOut.title: PageOut
PageOut.description: One page's extracted text, as stored.

PageSummary.title: PageSummary
PageSummary.description: A page in the list (no text): for choosing one to open.

PushConfigOut.title: PushConfigOut
PushConfigOut.description:
Whether the server can send push (its VAPID keys are set), and the public key the
browser subscribes with.

PushSubscriptionIn.title: PushSubscriptionIn
PushSubscriptionIn.description: A browser's PushSubscription, as ``subscription.toJSON()`` gives it, and a label.

PushSubscriptionOut.title: PushSubscriptionOut
PushSubscriptionOut.description: A device: never its endpoint (a capability) or keys.

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: What the model is asked for (3 questions); up to 6 are accepted, then filtered.

QuizAnswersIn.title: QuizAnswersIn
QuizAnswersIn.description: The student's pick for each question, in order (null for one not answered yet).

QuizQuestion.title: QuizQuestion
QuizQuestion.description: One multiple-choice question. Extra keys from the model are ignored.

RuleUpdate.title: RuleUpdate
RuleUpdate.description: Any of the three; the window is checked again once merged with what's stored.

SessionDetailOut.title: SessionDetailOut
SessionDetailOut.description: A session with its events in timeline order, for resuming the timer.

SessionPage.title: SessionPage
SessionPage.description: One page of a module's sessions: the open one first, then newest first.

SnippetPart.title: SnippetPart
SnippetPart.description: A run of snippet text; ``highlight`` marks words that matched the query.

SourceOut.title: SourceOut
SourceOut.description: A source as the student sees it before the answer: enough to link to the page.

SourcesEvent.title: SourcesEvent
SourcesEvent.description: First: the sources the answer is given (may be empty).

SubtreeWorkloadOut.title: SubtreeWorkloadOut
SubtreeWorkloadOut.description:
A topic's workload with its subtopics: what the planner uses when the topic is ticked
in an assessment (decision 0019). The student's own figure on the topic, else estimated
from the distinct pages linked anywhere in it (each page once).

TopicMove.title: TopicMove
TopicMove.description: Move a topic under ``parent_id`` (null = top level) at index ``position``.

TopicNodeOut.title: TopicNodeOut
TopicNodeOut.description: A topic with its subtopics, for rendering the tree.

TopicReviewStats.title: TopicReviewStats
TopicReviewStats.description:
What the student did with the AI's topics (decision 0009). Each AI topic counts once,
by the last thing done to it; ``unreviewed`` are those still marked AI.

VoiceTimingIn.title: VoiceTimingIn
VoiceTimingIn.description:
Measured in the browser for a question asked by voice, in ms from releasing
push-to-talk: the final transcript, the first answer token, the first full sentence,
and the first spoken word (``voice_latency_ms``, the Phase 3 target is under 2,500).

WorkloadOut.title: WorkloadOut
WorkloadOut.description: How long a topic takes: the student's figure, or an estimate from its pages.
